# stand
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package stand is the stand: the screen the artist sells from, at a fair or at home, with a basket, the total and «Cobrar». What it sells comes from a Source: the stock taken to one fair, or the whole catalogue.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `func ByProduct(items []Item) [][]Item` | ByProduct groups items into the versions of each product, keeping the order in which each product first appears: the stand shows one tile per product. |
| `type Basket struct{ ... }` | Basket is what one customer is taking, in the order it was tapped. |
| `type Fair struct{ ... }` | Fair sells the stock taken to one open fair; its sales belong to the fair. |
| `type Item struct{ ... }` | Item is one thing on the stand: a variant, its price and how many are left to sell. |
| `type Screens struct{ ... }` | Screens are the stand's pages: choosing a stand, and selling from it. |
| `func NewScreens(fairs *events.Store, products *catalogue.Store, sold *sales.Store, ...) *Screens` | NewScreens sells from the open fairs kept in fairs, or from the catalogue in products. |
| `type Source interface{ ... }` | Source is where a stand takes what it sells from, and where it records a sale. |
| `type Taken struct{ ... }` | Taken is one line of what a customer took, as a receipt reads it: "2 × Luna · Mate" and what those cost together. |
| `type WholeStock struct{ ... }` | WholeStock sells straight from the catalogue, at home or in a shop: a local sale. |
